children: Aprea announced expansion of its global intellectual property portfolio, totaling 28 issued and 30 pending patents to support its precision oncology programs.
Announced expanded IP portfolio: 28 issued patents and 30 pending patents worldwide, reinforcing program protection.
WEE1 program: 2 pending U.S. apps, 1 pending U.S. provisional, 2 granted non-U.S. patents, 12 pending non-U.S. apps; potential expiry 2047.
ATR program: 4 granted U.S. patents, 1 pending U.S. app, 1 pending international app, 22 granted non-U.S. and 13 pending non-U.S.; granted patents expire 2035–2037.
ATRN-119: RP2D of 1,100 mg QD determined in 2025; company paused monotherapy dose-escalation to prioritize APR-1051 and may pursue combination development.
